description: Send a new message and return the created conversation object(s) (id, subject, participants) — one per recipient. With more than one entry in recipients, this creates a separate private conversation with each recipient rather than one shared group thread: each recipient sees only their own copy, and nobody sees who else received it. Every call sends again — there is no dedup against an already-sent message with the same subject and body. recipients must be real Canvas user ids as strings; list_course_users or search_users can look those up first. Requires the authenticated user to have permission to message every recipient (course messaging rules and any inbox restrictions Canvas enforces). Use list_conversations and get_conversation to review what was sent.

recipients.description: Array of recipient user IDs (as strings)
